in_marathi.name: Sravan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sravan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sravan' meaning 'to hear', this name is associated with the monsoon season and the sound of rain. It is also the name of the month of Shravana in the Hindu calendar, which is celebrated for Lord Vishnu.
